subject: Staged dunning: Pinefield remittance hold + VAT split (APAC)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@pinefield.co>, AP Team <treasury@pinefield.co>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: Outstanding invoices and VAT allocation for multi-entity remit

Hi Aisha / Pinefield AP,

Following up on a set of overdue invoices that hit our ledger last week. Summary below: 
- INV-PINE-004 (EUR 82,400) — due 2027-03-22 — services rendered across EU/APAC entities
- INV-PINE-005 (USD 14,200) — due 2027-03-25 — marketplace integration work

We've seen the pay-run flagged in your system as "remit hold / entity mismatch". We realise Pinefield is reconciling cross-border VAT and entity assignment, but we need a clear short-term remediation so Redwood isn't forced to escalate through our dunning cadence.

As a next step please confirm: 
1) Target payment date for at least partial settlement (min 30% of total)
2) Which entity will appear on the remittance for INV-PINE-004 (EU vs APAC) so we can match VAT split on our side
3) Any documentation you need from us (invoices, export evidence, or contract references) — I attached the invoice and a proposed payment plan spreadsheet for your review.

If we don't hear back by EOD Friday (your local time) we'll move to step 2 of our dunning sequence and loop in collections leadership to request a short-term credit hold removal plan.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0194

Attachments: INV-PINE-004.pdf, payment-plan-proposal.xlsx

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@pinefield.co>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <treasury@pinefield.co>, Ravi Desai <ravi.desai@pinefield.co>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Outstanding invoices and VAT allocation for multi-entity remit

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear summary. Short context from our side: 
- Our treasury identified these invoices as multi-entity (EU services delivered to EU entity but contracted by APAC buyer). Tax needs to confirm VAT reclaim route before funds release.
- We have cash scheduled for 2027-04-07 but treasury needs the VAT breakdown mapped to entity IDs before they can create the payment instruction.

Proposed immediate action: we can release 40% of the combined balance on 2027-04-07 to your EUR account while tax completes validation. We'll need stamped service confirmations and the vendor VAT registration for the EU entity.

I will upload a scanned bank-proof for the 40% transfer once initiated. If you can route the VAT registration docs and a signed service confirmation by EOD tomorrow, that would help accelerate.

Regards,
Aisha Patel
Head of Treasury Operations
Pinefield Health
Aisha.Patel@pinefield.co

Attachments: bank-proof-screenshot.png

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@pinefield.co>, AP Team <treasury@pinefield.co>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 07:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Outstanding invoices and VAT allocation for multi-entity remit

On Thu, 1 Apr 2027 at 11:03 -0700, Aisha Patel wrote:
> Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear summary. Short context from our side:
> - Our treasury identified these invoices as multi-entity ...
> Proposed immediate action: we can release 40% on 2027-04-07...

Thanks — 40% partial is acceptable as an interim. We're preparing the VAT registration and signed service confirmations now and will upload to the SharePoint folder (link below) by COB tomorrow. 

Kimberly — can you review the proposed payment plan and confirm we should accept a 40% partial payment as "step 1" of the dunning resolution (and pause automated step 2 dunning for 7 days post-payment)? This will keep the customer in our collection pipeline without escalating to legal.

Link: https://redwood-internal.sharepoint.com/sites/collections/PINE-RemitEvidence

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Outstanding invoices and VAT allocation for multi-entity remit

Jonas — good work triaging. Quick internal callout before we confirm: 
- Accepting a 40% partial is reasonable operationally if we get the payment on 2027-04-07 and the VAT docs by 2027-04-08. We should formalize this as a "Staged Remit Agreement" (one-paragraph email commitment) to avoid ambiguity.
- Given the multi-entity angle and size (EUR 82k), elevate to collections leadership for visibility — Marcus, please review and advise whether we should flag for a short-term credit note or re-invoice under a single entity to simplify treasury flows.

Marissa — can you prepare the one-paragraph Staged Remit Agreement and include our standard clause about "no change to service scope" and the payment being allocated first to past-due invoices? Also include a DocuSign link if Pinefield prefers an e-signature. 

If Pinefield misses the 4/7 transfer we move to dunning step 2 (automated reminder + collections PM outreach).

Kimberly Park
Head of Credit & Collections
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec visibility: Pinefield staged remit and VAT triage

Kimberly / Jonas — reading the thread. I agree with the staged remit approach as a pragmatic resolution to avoid churn and the legal cost of a hard escalation. A couple of execution notes: 
1) If Pinefield requests re-invoicing under a single entity, get tax sign-off before doing that — reissue could create VAT recovery exposure unless we include a corrected invoice trail. 
2) Approve the 40% partial as long as Marissa's Staged Remit Agreement includes: payment date, split plan for remaining balance, and an explicit acknowledgement of the outstanding VAT responsibility.
3) I'll mark this as "collections leadership standby" — if payment is not received by 2027-04-10 we'll authorize a direct outreach to Pinefield's CFO to request exec touchpoint.

Please loop in Legal if Pinefield pushes for a netting arrangement or contract amendment.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: none in this message
